description: Explicit settings-variance evidence claims. The inventory generator derives every registered option from PrintConfigDef and marks all other options uncovered.
default_uncovered_reason: No dedicated settings-variance evidence is declared for this registered option; full_print_config() construction, schema serialization, and source coverage do not establish behavior.

sparse_infill_pattern.reason: Every registered sparse pattern is deserialized and required to emit sparse-role geometry; rectilinear and gyroid are also exercised with both wall generators as a bounded interaction pair.

top_surface_pattern.reason: Every registered top pattern is deserialized and required to emit top-solid geometry, with monotonic and concentric output compared.

bottom_surface_pattern.reason: Every registered bottom pattern is deserialized and required to emit bottom-surface geometry, with monotonic and concentric output compared.

wall_generator.reason: Classic and Arachne are deserialized, sliced on a ledged fixture, and required to produce distinct perimeter evidence; each is paired with two sparse patterns.

ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.reason: Every registered shell-thickness mode is deserialized and sliced; none and all must produce distinct solid-infill evidence.

seam_position.reason: Every registered seam position is deserialized and sliced; nearest and random must move the first outer-wall start in emitted G-code.

sparse_infill_density.reason: Zero, nominal, and full density are applied to a real slice and checked for absent sparse geometry, sparse geometry, and solid geometry respectively.

wall_loops.reason: Zero, one, and four wall loops are applied to a real slice; perimeter counts and lengths distinguish disabled, nominal, and expanded behavior.

top_shell_layers.reason: Zero, one, and two top-shell layers are applied to a real slice; zero disables top coverage, while extremal solid fill-surface layer counts and areas distinguish one from two.

bottom_shell_layers.reason: Zero, one, and two bottom-shell layers are applied to a real slice; zero disables bottom coverage, while extremal solid fill-surface layer counts and areas distinguish one from two.

layer_height.reason: The fixture sets a valid layer height so other settings can reach the slicing pipeline; it does not claim boundary or interaction coverage for layer height.

initial_layer_print_height.reason: The fixture supplies a valid initial-layer height; no dedicated variance oracle claims its boundary behavior.

top_shell_thickness.reason: The fixture sets top-shell thickness to zero to make layer-count behavior deterministic; no dedicated thickness variance oracle is claimed.

bottom_shell_thickness.reason: The fixture sets bottom-shell thickness to zero to make layer-count behavior deterministic; no dedicated thickness variance oracle is claimed.

top_surface_density.reason: The fixture enables top-surface material so surface-pattern tests have an observable role; no density boundary claim is made.

bottom_surface_density.reason: The fixture enables bottom-surface material so surface-pattern tests have an observable role; no density boundary claim is made.

gcode_comments.reason: The exporter is run with comments enabled and disabled; the test requires comment text to change while the parsed motion stream remains identical.

layer_change_gcode.reason: The fixture supplies a self-contained layer-change command for G-code generation; it does not claim custom-G-code boundary or interaction coverage.

ironing_type.reason: The pipeline comparison covers no ironing and topmost ironing, requiring the latter to emit ironing paths; the top and solid enum values are covered elsewhere but are not claimed here.

ironing_spacing.reason: The test compares zero and sub-minimum spacing with IRONING_SPACING_MIN in emitted ironing paths; it establishes the lower clamp behavior without claiming the full numeric boundary domain.

filament_ironing_spacing.reason: The filament override path is compared at zero and sub-minimum spacing with IRONING_SPACING_MIN in emitted ironing paths; upper and per-filament boundary coverage is not claimed.

solid_infill_rotate_template.reason: Layered solid-fill angle output is checked for a fixed step, a seven-angle list, and a two-layer run modifier; arbitrary template syntax is not claimed exhaustive.

sparse_infill_rotate_template.reason: A seven-angle sparse-fill template is required to repeat in the emitted layer sequence; other template forms and malformed strings are not claimed.

solid_infill_direction.reason: Solid-fill angles at directions zero and thirty degrees are compared layer by layer, establishing the configured offset without claiming angular boundary coverage.

sparse_infill_smooth_factor.reason: Multiple fill families compare unsmoothed and fully smoothed paths using point, turn, and connectivity oracles; intermediate percentages are not claimed exhaustive.

fill_multiline.reason: Multiline fill tests exercise one, two, and three lines and check path connectivity and shape invariants; the complete integer range is not claimed.

separated_infills.reason: The same multi-body fixtures run with separation disabled and enabled, requiring body-local infill matching or the expected shared-origin difference.

tpms_adaptive.reason: Adaptive TPMS tests exercise disabled, lobes, stepped shells, smooth blend, distance warp, and normal-axis modes with density and invariance oracles; normal_y and the full enum domain are not claimed exhaustive.

tpms_interior_density.reason: Adaptive TPMS fixtures use five, twenty-five, and forty percent interior density and compare measured core and shell infill; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

tpms_adaptive_gradient.reason: The adaptive-gradient test runs linear, quadratic, and exponential and checks their measured surface-to-core ordering, covering every registered enum value.

gyroid_optimized.reason: Adaptive gyroid output is generated with optimization disabled and enabled and the complete printed sequence is compared.

infill_direction.reason: The sparse anchor test sets a forty-five-degree direction and matches generated anchors against printed infill; angular boundaries are not claimed.

align_infill_direction_to_model.reason: The sparse anchor matrix runs both model-aligned states, including a rotated instance, and checks the emitted paths against generated anchors.

only_one_wall_top.reason: A three-wall fixture is sliced with the option disabled and enabled; the top-layer perimeter count must decrease when only one wall is allowed.

only_one_wall_first_layer.reason: A three-wall fixture is sliced with the option disabled and enabled; the first-layer perimeter count must decrease when only one wall is allowed.

extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.reason: An overhang fixture is sliced with extra overhang perimeters disabled and enabled; the enabled result must contain more perimeter paths.

overhang_reverse.reason: An overhang fixture is sliced with reversal disabled and enabled; signed external-perimeter winding must change.

is_infill_first.reason: Both ordering states are sliced and the first non-first-layer extrusion role must begin with perimeter or infill accordingly.

spiral_mode.reason: A sloped fixture is sliced with spiral mode disabled and enabled; parsed G-code must show no extruding Z moves versus continuous extruding Z motion.

thick_bridges.reason: A bridge fixture is sliced with thick bridges disabled and enabled; both emit bridge paths and their rounded-versus-normal flow volume per unit path must differ.

enable_arc_fitting.reason: A curved-cylinder fixture is exported with arc fitting disabled and enabled; the G-code must contain zero versus positive G2/G3 moves.

detect_thin_wall.reason: A perpendicular sub-nozzle fin is sliced with thin-wall detection disabled and enabled; the enabled result must add external-perimeter medial-axis paths extending beyond the body edge.

fuzzy_skin_first_layer.reason: External fuzzy skin is sliced with first-layer fuzz disabled and enabled; the emitted perimeter length must change.

hole_to_polyhole.reason: A circular through-hole fixture is sliced with conversion disabled and enabled; the resulting hole vertex count must differ.

hole_to_polyhole_twisted.reason: A converted hole is sliced with twisted conversion disabled and enabled; the first-hole checksum must change.

brim_use_efc_outline.reason: A compensated brim fixture is sliced with EFC outline compensation disabled and enabled; both brims must exist and their outline checksum must differ.

center_of_surface_pattern.reason: The surface-centering regression generates each_surface, each_model, and each_assembly and requires a changed center to alter paths while a reslice matches a fresh slice; it does not claim every enum transition independently.

enable_support.reason: Support-disabled and support-enabled overhang slices are compared and require zero versus positive support points.

support_on_build_plate_only.reason: Both states are sliced on a two-tier fixture and must produce different positive support-point counts.

support_ironing.reason: Support interface layers are sliced with support ironing disabled and enabled; the enabled result must add support-ironing paths.

support_interface_top_layers.reason: Configured top interface counts one, two, three, four, and six are checked against emitted support-interface layers; the full integer range is not claimed.

support_interface_bottom_layers.reason: Bottom interface counts zero, one, three, and six plus the top-count sentinel are checked in emitted support layers; full boundary coverage is not claimed.

support_interface_pattern.reason: Support interface tests exercise auto, rectilinear, rectilinear interlaced, concentric, and grid mappings through direct and emitted-angle oracles; spiralinset is not claimed.

support_bottom_interface_spacing.reason: Bottom interface spacing zero and four are compared across support styles and require denser output at zero; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

gcode_flavor.reason: Relative and absolute extrusion are checked for Marlin, Klipper, and RepRapFirmware with parsed deposition and path totals; the remaining registered firmware flavors are not claimed.

use_relative_e_distances.reason: Both relative and absolute extrusion modes are exported and parsed, requiring M83 versus M82 and equal positive deposited material and XY path length.

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.reason: The exporter sets an initial-layer temperature of 211 and requires that value in emitted thermal commands; the integer range is not claimed.

nozzle_temperature.reason: The exporter sets a regular nozzle temperature of 203 and requires that value in emitted thermal commands; the integer range is not claimed.

initial_layer_fan_speed.reason: The exporter sets initial-layer fan speed zero and requires an emitted fan-off command; the full percent domain is not claimed.

full_fan_speed_layer.reason: The exporter sets the full-speed transition at layer two and requires full-speed fan output; other transition counts are not claimed.

close_fan_the_first_x_layers.reason: The cooling pipeline holds the fan off for five configured initial layers and requires an explicit M106 S0 command; boundary counts are not claimed.

fan_min_speed.reason: The multifilament cooling matrix varies minimum fan speeds by extruder variant and requires the corresponding emitted PWM percentages; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

fan_max_speed.reason: The multifilament cooling matrix varies maximum fan speeds by extruder variant and requires the corresponding emitted PWM percentages; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.reason: Machine-envelope tests enable the option and require M201, M203, M204, and M205 limits in emitted G-code; the disabled branch is not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_extruding.reason: Single- and multi-extruder machine-envelope tests set extruding acceleration values and require the selected maximum in M204 output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_retracting.reason: Single- and multi-extruder machine-envelope tests set retracting acceleration values and require the selected maximum in M204 output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_travel.reason: Single- and multi-extruder machine-envelope tests set travel acceleration values and require the selected maximum in M204 output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_junction_deviation.reason: Machine-envelope tests set junction deviation values and require their selected maximum in M205 J output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.
